description: Checks the answers the business owner gave you and returns the one link they open on clearwatercapitalgrp.com to review every answer, add their own identity details, consent and sign. Stores nothing and sends nothing. Get the owner's OK on their answers first. Never include a Social Security number, date of birth, or bank login.

amount_requested.description: Required. Dollars the owner wants, as a whole number (for example 75000).

average_monthly_revenue.description: Required. Average monthly deposits into the business bank account, in dollars.

business_legal_name.description: Required. Legal name of the business, as registered.

business_start_month.description: Required. Month and year the business opened, as YYYY-MM.

ein.description: The business's 9-digit Employer Identification Number (EIN). Never a Social Security number. Required unless the entity_type is "Sole Prop" and the business has no EIN.

entity_type.description: Required. How the business is registered.

estimated_credit_score.description: Required. Owner's best guess at their personal credit score, 300 to 850. A guess is fine.

funding_history.description: Required. Anything that has ever happened with a business lender or cash advance. "none" for a clean history, otherwise any of the other options. In a review link, separate with commas.

industry.description: Required. What the business does, in a few words (for example "Plumbing" or "Restaurant").

merchant_processor.description: Card processor, if the business takes cards (for example Square or Stripe).

monthly_card_volume.description: Monthly credit card sales in dollars, if any.

notes.description: Anything underwriting should know: why now, a slow season, a big contract.

anyOf.description: "none", or "Lender, balance, payment, frequency" entries separated by semicolons

open_advances_or_loans.description: Required. Every merchant cash advance or business loan the business pays today. "none" if none. Otherwise a list of { "lender", "balance", "payment", "frequency" } (frequency: daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). In a review link, write each as "Lender, balance, payment, frequency" separated by semicolons.

owner_home_state.description: Required. 2-letter US state code of the owner's home.

owner_title.description: Required. Owner's title (for example Owner, CEO, Managing Member).

ownership_percent.description: Required. Percent of the business the owner holds, 1 to 100.

primary_bank.description: Required. Bank that holds the main business checking account.

timing.description: Required. How soon the owner needs the funds: same_day (within 24 hours), this_week (2-5 days), one_two_weeks, thirty_days (30+ days).

use_of_funds.description: Required. What the money is for.

name: create_review_link
title: Make the owner's review link
